IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with soft, wavy light
brown hair stands in a snowy garden. She wears a
long, fit-and-flare cream wool coat with a brown fur
collar and matching brown fur cuffs, and a brown
fur pillbox hat. Cream knit gloves rest together at
her waist. Her expression is calm and composed.
Overcast winter light and a bare tree in the
background. Palette of cream, chocolate brown,
and snow white. Classic and vintage, in the style of
a mid-century winter fashion plate.
